name: @dsh-agent/dsh-agent-memory
description: Agent-facing memory layer (increment 1, I1 foundation + I1.2 scoring calibration + I2 residual-pyramid triage): four narrow tools (remember/recall/expand/prune) over a human-readable NDJSON store with a fail-closed write protocol, atomic writes, hard caps with score-based eviction, and zero runtime dependencies. I1.2 scoring: BM25 with per-field statistics, absolute-scale display (no batch normalization), VCP-style tag coverage as a diagnostic column, and MMR diversity multiplied into the printed score. I2 triage: a Gram-Schmidt residual pyramid over the tag-idf lexical space (novelty = 0.7*residualRatio + 0.3*directionConsistency) decides whether recall widens kBase -> kExpanded; all pyramid state is request-local (no module-level cache), and low confidence is only reported, never used to veto. I4a: one stable, query-independent memory-index line injected into the system prompt's trailing runtime-context block via ctx.systemPrompt.context({name:'agent-memory', order:200, text}) — count + global tag-frequency anchors + tool pointer, hard maxChars budget with an honest omission marker, an off switch, fail-open on any read/parse error (never throws), and an idempotent read-only cache keyed strictly by {path, size, mtimeMs}. I4a.1: `inject` is narrowed to ['tools'] and the injection surface is registered conditionally via ctx.inject(['systemPrompt'], scope => scope.systemPrompt.context(...)) — a missing systemPrompt costs only the injection line, never the four tools (the old hard dependency made the whole plugin skip apply()). I3: an ordered bidirectional tag co-occurrence graph built per call from the current store (directed counts kept separate per direction, log(1+lambda*W) compression instead of linear accumulation, per-node outflow normalised to a fixed budget, hub suppression (inDegree/median)^-eta), plus bounded pulse propagation (maxHops/maxStates/maxFieldNeighbors, decay gamma, immediate backflow suppression rho) that adds a capped auxiliary reward graph <= GRAPH_BONUS_CAP to the ranking (final = rel + graph, rel stays the BM25 score that decides match); zero module-level mutable state, propagation is request-local, and the injection line is untouched.

scripts.test: node test/protocol.test.mjs && node test/cap.test.mjs && node test/pure.test.mjs && node test/scoring.test.mjs && node test/recall.test.mjs && node test/triage.test.mjs && node test/lossless.test.mjs && node test/storage.test.mjs && node test/prune.test.mjs && node test/inject.test.mjs && node test/loose-inject.test.mjs && node test/graph.test.mjs
